response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, embedded, and distributed systems, but the resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, A/B testing, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this role. His career progression (Senior/Staff titles) and project scope also don't clearly demonstrate the multi-team architectural leadership expected at Principal/IC6 level.
strengths: 15+ years of broad technical experience across multiple languages (C, C++, C#, Java, JS/TS) and platforms
Demonstrated technical leadership: staff-level roles, workshops, open-source platform ownership (GISCollective)
Experience with high-throughput, low-latency backend systems at Dunnhumby (millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-metrics platform experience
No demonstrated data science/statistical analysis or bias/rollout-risk management background
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff titles rather than Principal-level cross-team architectural ownership

key_factors.factor: Broad, deep general engineering experience (8+ years, multiple languages, scale)
No clear evidence of Principal-level multi-team technical leadership or data/metrics aptitude
